findings.governingReading: Illya introduces herself as pupil number one, riding a comic wave of momentum.
findings.explanation: Senior student again substitutes seniority for her numbered Tiger Dojo role.

findings.highlight: Why did you do a full swing on me
findings.evidenceJa: なんでフルスイングするの
findings.governingReading: Illya protests that Taiga struck her with a full swing.
findings.explanation: Do a full swing on me is nonidiomatic English.

findings.highlight: such an attack won’t affect me
findings.governingReading: Illya childishly taunts that the spoiler-prohibition sword did not hit her.
findings.explanation: Won’t affect me changes a physical miss into lack of effect after contact.

findings.governingReading: Taiga calls the scenario’s balance characteristically delicate, questionable, or finely poised.
findings.explanation: Difficult describes player challenge rather than the precarious quality of the balance design.

findings.governingReading: Taiga answers with the deliberately mangled, cat-tinged acknowledgment “nyarupeso.”
findings.explanation: I see removes the nonsense pronunciation and its continuation of the cat-comedy register.

findings.evidenceJa: 若さ故に無謀溢れる選択肢
findings.governingReading: Taiga urges choosing the option overflowing with recklessness born of youth.
findings.explanation: Immature adds a negative judgment of the chooser’s maturity instead of attributing the recklessness to youth.
